# AI agents for operations: playbook

> A playbook of AI agent use cases for operations, finance and revenue teams: job descriptions, approval steps, workflow-versus-agent guidance and MCP setup. The agents are Stacksync Genies, which read connected ERP, CRM, database and support systems and act across them with approval steps and a run log. Code examples show how to connect an agent to the Stacksync MCP server.

Stacksync AI agents: https://www.stacksync.com/ai-agents
Stacksync MCP: https://www.stacksync.com/mcp
MCP server URL: https://mcp.stacksync.com/mcp
Official skills: https://github.com/stacksyncdata/skills

## Playbooks

- playbooks/01-freight-invoice-disputes.md
- playbooks/02-invoice-and-document-intake.md
- playbooks/03-payout-reconciliation.md
- playbooks/04-closed-won-onboarding.md
- playbooks/05-account-enrichment.md
- playbooks/06-ticket-escalation.md
- playbooks/07-order-questions-from-slack.md
- playbooks/08-sync-issue-triage.md

## Code

- code/mcp-configs: config files for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf and VS Code
- code/skills: example Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for invoice reconciliation, account enrichment and ticket escalation
- code/clients: minimal Python and Node MCP clients using an API key
